contract.syntax: Opt-in SET VAR/SET VARIABLE and SHOW VAR final PATH/QUEUE_TYPE ARRAY rows/planes with static comma/chained indexes and exact remaining schemas
contract.capture: Metadata-only original-cell location through an explicit collection resource policy; ordinary generic data codecs remain closed
contract.budget: Charge both selections before copying. A live prefix side charges its complete containing bank; other sides charge selected data. Each admitted bank/value fits 32767 descriptor/header/node/queue-pair units.
contract.target: Retain original reference location/store/owner object and selected parent/backing cells; re-resolve after checkpoints and recheck whole-owner aliases/timers/protection
contract.source: Resolve current source after final charge with exact admitted schema/count. Clone the complete containing owner before selecting independent prepared data.
contract.validation: Reject malformed/over-limit/shared owned siblings and changed admitted counts before publication; preserve valid partial PATH data and uninitialized queues
contract.publication: Retain receiver cells/headers, replace PATH nodes independently, reset only copied queue buffer links, preserve unselected data and support same-bank/self-copy
contract.inspection: Bounded typed SHOW rows with remaining dimensions and queue sequences; no storage/link/cache edits or partial output on invalid data
contract.persistence: Existing closed JSON values/creation metadata/history only; no selected view, queue buffer link, live alias or suspended execution

boundaries: No paused-local collection roots/prefixes, FILE copying or resource STRUCTURE fields
No implicit schema conversion, reshape, expression indexes or source discovery
No rollback of earlier independent callback/checkpoint effects
Authored offline Pythonic contract; no native/controller/strict equivalence
